### MINI D20

MINI D20 is a role-playing game by Seba. This deck is fan material and reproduces the rules of the campaign on the river.

### Picture credits

- Icons from [game-icons.net](https://game-icons.net/), CC BY 3.0: Delapouite, Lorc, sbed.
- The drawings are our own.

### Fonts

Merriweather and Wellfleet, both under the SIL Open Font License.

## Notes

The cover in English — the same deck title over the wordmark, its licences on the back from the note's own text, the captions from the `en` tables. Out of the German deck. This section is a property nobody binds and stays off the card.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: cover
  language: en
data:
  name: Campaign on the River
  subtitle: A card deck for MINI D20
  footer: Edition 1 · 2026
```
